formal_statement: have x1 : List ((Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool) := (List.ofFn fun (x1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) (x2 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x2 x1) ++ [fun (x1 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x1 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x1 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]; ∀ (x2 : List ((Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool)),   (∀ (x3 : Fin x2.length),       have x4 : List ((Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool) := (fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => Bool.false) :: (fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => Bool.true) :: (x1 ++ List.take (↑x3) x2);       ∃ x5 ∈ x4, ∃ x6 ∈ x4, (x2.get x3 = fun (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x5 x7 && x6 x7) ∨ (x2.get x3 = fun (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x5 x7 || x6 x7) ∨ x2.get x3 = fun (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => !x5 x7) →     (fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) ∈ (fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => Bool.false) :: (x1 ++ x2) → (15 : ℕ) ≤ x2.length
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Any list of functions, each the AND or OR of two earlier ones or the NOT of one, starting from the nine inputs, the function AND(x_0, x_4) and the two constants, that contains the edge function has at least 15 steps.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_4) computes its edge function
